events.title: The Ultimate Doom Sweepstakes
events.summary: Collect Ultimate Doom Raffle Tickets and enter the official sweepstakes during the published event window.

events.title: Alliance Super Season
events.summary: A multiplayer-focused season with Solo Objectives, a Realm Event and Bounty Missions, announced in the October 30 livestream recap.

events.title: Beast Rework Double Track
events.summary: The reworked Beast is scheduled to appear in a Double Track across this published window.

events.title: The Tower of Doom
events.summary: A timed Event Tower with 10 blocks and six fights per block. Hidden combat actions can add or remove time from your run.

events.title: Alliance Coliseum
events.summary: A five-day Alliance Coliseum test featuring a Tigra fight, as announced in the October 30 livestream recap.

events.title: Beast’s Bounty Missions
events.summary: Alliance-based bounty missions featuring regular, Elite and timed targets, Bounty Credits, Bounty Boxes and Reported Findings rewards.

events.title: Battlegrounds Season 44
events.summary: Season 44 is scheduled for 42 days, with a permanent 40-champion deck, expanded draft, three swaps per match and five bans announced in the livestream recap.

events.title: Summoner's Choice 2027 · Final Round
events.summary: The final published voting window for Summoner's Choice 2027. It remains visible briefly as a recently ended event.

news.title: Stream Recap · November 2, 2026
news.summary: Kabam detailed the Empire of Doom saga, Reclamation War, Sieges, Victorious 4, Tower of Doom, Stellar-Forged Magik and the November 20 Quantum Tangle event.

news.title: Empire of Doom & Reclamation War Are Live
news.summary: The November–January saga centers on Reclamation War: weekly Realm Events, Swift Rivalry, Sieges, Doomscrip, Victorious 4 rewards and the chase for Doctor Doom.

news.title: Sieges Introduced for Reclamation War
news.summary: Gatekeeper and Siege Overlord encounters introduce global-health bosses, limited entries, milestone unlocks and saga rewards during Reclamation War.

news.title: Stellar-Forged Magik Piece Locations
news.summary: Kabam published the first acquisition path for Stellar-Forged Magik, including Reclamation War participation, the November Side Quest and Battlegrounds Season 44.

news.title: Beast’s Bounty Missions Announced
news.summary: The November 18–December 9 Side Quest uses Alliance participation to unlock bounty boards, Elite targets, timed bounties and Bounty Credit reward boxes.

news.title: Quantum Tangle Coming November 20
news.summary: Kabam previewed the November 20 Cyber Weekend event with Unit and Webstore bundles, build-your-own offers, a free bundle and featured Medusa and Ghost acquisition opportunities.

news.title: Stream Recap · October 30, 2026
news.summary: Kabam previewed the Beast rework, Multiversal Meltdown, Alliance Super Season, Alliance Coliseum, Battlegrounds Season 44 and other upcoming content.

news.title: Summoner's Choice 2027
news.summary: The official event page details the 2027 community champion vote and its published voting windows.

news.title: Battlegrounds Season 43 Announced
news.summary: Season 43 introduced refreshed Victory Track and Gladiator Circuit rewards and previewed the longer Season 44 format.
